cases.sentence: А Боаз тем временем направился к ___ и сел там.
cases.explain: «городским воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.

cases.sentence: (В ___ в Израиле, чтобы выкупить или передать права на собственность, один из участников сделки снимал свою сандалию и отдавал ее другому.
cases.explain: «прежние времена» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.

cases.sentence: Еще я приобрел моавитянку Руфь, вдову Махлона, себе в жены, чтобы сохранить землю за семьей покойного, чтобы его имя не исчезло среди его родичей и от ворот его ___.
cases.explain: «родного города» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”

cases.sentence: Пусть через потомство, которое Господь даст тебе от этой ___, твой род уподобится роду Пареца, которого Фамарь родила Иуде .
cases.explain: «молодой женщины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which Yahweh will give you by this young woman.”
